# @loom/conformance

Portable SPI conformance kits for Loom — run run<Spi>Conformance(factory) in your vitest suite to prove a store/dispatcher/timer/projection backend conforms. Ships ESM so `import vitest` resolves natively; vitest is a peer.

## Entry points

- `@loom/conformance`

## Install

Unpublished for now: inside this repo use `workspace:*`; from a sibling checkout use a `link:` override (see [AGENTS.md](../../AGENTS.md)).
